summary: Iteration 12 — Both backend + frontend verified end-to-end. Backend pytest: 5/5 PASS (root GET /health on localhost:8001 → 200 {status:ok}; external ingress returns non-ok as expected since ingress only routes /api; /api/auth/me + /api/subscription/me + /api/subscription/sync all 200 with Bearer test_session_macros_001). Frontend UI (375x667 mobile viewport, token injected via localStorage): (1) FREE flow — profile-subscription card shows 'Ücretsiz Sürüm' and tap → /paywall; (2) Paywall — ₺299 + '3 GÜN ÜCRETSİZ DENE' badge render, paywall-subscribe click shows the expected informational alert ('Satın alma yalnızca App Store / Google Play...'), paywall-restore shows the same info alert, /legal/terms and /legal/privacy both open; (3) PRO flow — after POST /api/subscription/sync {is_pro:true} + reload, profile card shows 'BESLENCE AI Pro' + checkmark, tapping the card invokes manageSubscription() which correctly falls back to Linking.openURL — a new tab is opened to https://play.google.com/store/account/subscriptions (Google sign-in wrapper), NO redbox / crash on the app tab (URL stayed on /profile); (4) REGRESSION — /chatbot and /report render for pro (no paywall redirect); teardown restored is_pro=false. Non-blocking RN-Web console warnings observed on /report screen: 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin' (should be transformOrigin), 'shadow* style props deprecated', 'props.pointerEvents deprecated' — internal to react-native-web, not blocking. No deprecated Expo packages (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch) found in the tested code paths.

issues: Non-blocking React DOM warning: 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin. Did you mean transformOrigin?' — an animated element (likely a ring/donut chart) is passing kebab-case CSS to react-native-web. Cosmetic, no visual break, but appears as a red console error.

action_items: (Optional cosmetic) In the /report screen ring/chart component, replace the kebab-case CSS 'transform-origin' with the camelCase 'transformOrigin' prop to silence the React DOM warning on web.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:42 — root-level @app.get('/health') registered BEFORE the /api APIRouter mount is correct: it is not shadowed by /api prefix and returns the exact {status:'ok'} the deployment probe expects.

frontend/src/revenuecat.ts:79 manageSubscription() has clean graceful degradation: when the native module or config is missing (web / Expo Go) it falls through to Linking.openURL with the correct platform-specific store URL. Verified live — web preview opens play.google.com/store/account/subscriptions in a new tab without crashing.
frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx:74 — onPress correctly branches: isPro → manageSubscription(); free → router.push('/paywall'). No stale state issues.
